name: Manukau Road
insp: Cartographic flyover storytelling and warm illustrated-map product sites
desc: A warm, daylight illustrated map of Epsom draws itself in behind the headline, then tilts into 3D and glides up Manukau Road to number 620, where the office pin rises and the map opens into the real team photo.
fx: Pinned 3D map flyover along Manukau Road
Office pin rises, then a circular reveal into the team photo
Headline splits in by words while the map draws itself
Service photos settle inside their masks as cards rise
Pinned route sequence for the five promises
Cursor turns into a map pin over the map; team portraits follow the cursor
